title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Glassdoor Canada pools listings that also surface via Indeed and other aggregators, alongside a smaller set of titles unique to this site — the score measures technical/domain fit only, not pay or location.
latest_update: Latest update: September 19, 2026 — first run written to this schema; confirmed one exact duplicate against an already-rejected Indeed posting (Morson) plus several titles not seen on Indeed.

stats.label: confirmed duplicate of an Indeed posting

rows.title: Site Reliability Engineer
rows.gap: AWS multi-account + EKS/Kubernetes 'at scale' ownership is deeper than Marc's provisioning-side K8s depth (CKA in progress, not complete); otherwise strong overlap — incident command, Terraform/Ansible IaC, Datadog observability, and explicit AI-assisted-engineering tooling (Amazon Kiro) matching Marc's own Énergir practice

rows.title: Observability / DevOps Advisor
rows.gap: Salary range straddles the $120k Montréal on-site/hybrid floor — most of the range sits below it, only the top clears; otherwise a strong fit: Terraform CI/CD, Dynatrace/Elasticsearch observability, insurance-sector regulated environment, and explicit enterprise-AI-tooling emphasis. Bilingual requirement is a Marc asset, not a gap.

rows.title: Platform Engineer
rows.gap: Requires self-hosted Kubernetes cluster administration — a real depth gap (Marc's K8s experience is provisioning/automation-side, not deep node/cluster ops); GCP-or-AWS requirement is flexible, not a hard gate on its own

rows.title: Senior Platform & AI Systems Engineer
rows.location: Victoria, BC — hybrid, onsite as needed
rows.gap: Location hard-gate — Victoria BC is far outside Marc's reachable on-site/hybrid range (Ottawa/Kingston/Brockville/Cornwall/Montréal); otherwise this would have scored 8+ (AWS/Azure/Terraform/K8s, explicit daily use of Claude Code/OpenAI Codex, SRE ownership, no people-management requirement)

rows.title: Verification and Validation Developer – Infrastructure & Automation
rows.gap: Domain mismatch — center of gravity is RF/wireless/embedded test-lab automation (spectrum analyzers, signal generators, LTE/5G) rather than cloud/platform engineering; also requires eligibility for Canadian Security Clearance

rows.title: Senior Azure Cloud DevOps Specialist
rows.location: Ottawa, ON — hybrid, 3 days/week in office
rows.gap: Confirmed duplicate of the Morson Talent posting already filed and Rejected via Indeed on 2026-09-15 (score 2) — same title, same rate range, same recruiter family. Also requires Secret/CGP/Trade clearance (unconfirmed) and the rate is below target for a 3-days/week on-site cadence.

rows.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
rows.gap: Hard gate — AWS Serverless/Containers implementation experience is mandatory and explicitly states 'support or DevOps experience is NOT relevant'; the deliverable is AWS-native architecture ownership (Lambda, ECS Fargate, CDK/CloudFormation) at exactly the scale profile.md's hard-gate rule excludes

rows.title: DevOps Engineer
rows.gap: Hard gate — posting states production experience with both GCP and AWS is 'non-negotiable'

rows.title: Conseiller DevOps / DevSecOps sénior
rows.gap: Hard gate — requires hands-on professional experience with Google Cloud Platform as the primary environment (GCP landing zones, GCP certifications as an asset); Marc has zero GCP exposure. Would otherwise have been an excellent match on salary and Montréal hybrid location.

rows.title: Senior DevOps Specialist (SaaS Healthcare)
rows.gap: Hard gate — posting explicitly requires candidates to reside in the province of Quebec; Marc is based in Smiths Falls, ON. Same recurring employer-level residency gate seen on an earlier MEDFAR posting via Indeed.

rows.title: Platform Engineer
rows.gap: Domain mismatch — deep distributed-systems backend engineering (Go, Kafka, ClickHouse, event-driven architecture at billions-of-events scale) is the actual job, not infrastructure/DevOps

rows.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
rows.location: Calgary, AB — onsite/hybrid, 3 days/week in office
rows.gap: Location hard-gate (Calgary is outside the reachable range) compounded by an AWS-native architecture-ownership hard gate — CloudFormation StackSets, multi-account AWS Organizations, and IAM/networking ownership are the actual deliverables

notes_sections.heading: Indeed/Glassdoor overlap — direct answer to this run's question
items: One confirmed exact duplicate this run: Morson Group's "Senior Azure Cloud DevOps Specialist" (Ottawa, $89.30/hr) is the same req as Morson Talent's posting already filed and Rejected via Indeed on 2026-09-15 — same title, same rate, same recruiter family, just listed under a slightly different company-display name ("Morson Group" vs. "Morson Talent").

Beyond that single confirmed case, most of this run's 12 validated postings were titles not seen on Indeed in the current pipeline (Tecsys, Intact, Xsolla, Codan/Zetron, Octasic, BMO, CUBE84, Shiki, MEDFAR, Hookdeck, Wissen) — Glassdoor is pulling a materially different inventory from a mostly overlapping employer pool this run, not a re-skin of the same postings.

MEDFAR's Quebec-residency hard gate recurred on a different posting than the one previously seen via Indeed on 2026-08-20 — same employer-level policy, different req, reinforcing this as a standing company rule rather than a one-off.
Deloitte's Azure Cloud Engineer posting (seen again in this run's raw results) is a known duplicate of an already-filed Indeed posting from a prior run — not re-added to the table above.

notes_sections.heading: Keyword reliability this run
items: "DevOps Engineer" (N=22) and "DevSecOps Engineer" (N=25) both phrase-matched cleanly (91 and 19 results respectively) — the two usable keywords this run.

"Platform Engineer" reconfirmed as structurally unusable regardless of N — every N tried matches literal "engine" jobs (1,111 results dominated by mechanical/electrical/game-engine noise), consistent with the 2026-09-08 finding that this is inherent to Glassdoor's matching, not a URL-encoding bug.

"Site Reliability Engineer" reconfirmed the same inherent-noise problem — 266 results dominated by mechanical/electrical "reliability engineer" roles (rail, mining, hardware), not SRE. Neither keyword is worth retrying with different N values.
Did not run Cloud Engineer or Forward Deployed Engineer this pass — boundary for a follow-up run.

method: Searched Glassdoor Canada via the canada-<keyword>-jobs URL pattern, screened 79 results across the two keywords that phrase-match cleanly (DevOps Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer), and opened 12 postings to full description for scoring. Platform Engineer and Site Reliability Engineer were tried but abandoned after confirming (again) that Glassdoor's matching returns literal-substring noise for both regardless of the N parameter — not worth the review time. Cloud Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer were not attempted this run. No formal eligibility gate is needed (the canada- URL prefix scopes results by construction), so hard-gate postings (AWS/GCP-ownership-at-scale, unreachable on-site location, provincial residency) are scored low rather than excluded, per profile.md's red-flag rules.
